title: Lease ends about nine years before the permitted operating life
why: Land control ends in 2060 but the permission runs to about 2069. Nine years of permitted operation have no land rights, which affects valuation and debt tenor.
how: The lease runs 35 years from 1 January 2026, so it ends in 2060. Planning permission lasts 40 years from first export, expected in 2029, so it runs to about 2069.

citation.quote: for a term of 35 years from and including 1 January 2026

evidence.heading: 3. Term
evidence.paragraph_text: The Landlord lets the Property to the Tenant for a term of 35 years from and including 1 January 2026.

citation.quote: The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period of 40 years from the date of First Export

evidence.heading: Condition 3: Temporary permission
evidence.paragraph_text: The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period of 40 years from the date of First Export, after which the site shall be restored.
